claims.statement: The workflow supports reviewable campaign planning and bounded optimization decisions.
A clean trial reviews a synthetic campaign without a paid API or platform write.
Creative claims are screened against category, phrase and substantiation controls.
Blocked feedback cases emit no optimization recommendation or platform write.
Two validation projects were screened without forcing unnecessary dependencies.
Synthetic creative feedback links classification, decision, replay and regression evidence.
Policy currency, synthetic-data and human-authority limitations remain explicit.
Minimum-sample assumptions are exposed per performance cell and prevent low-information cells from qualifying for scale recommendations.

boundaries: Policy rules are a screening aid and require current platform, product and jurisdiction review.
All campaign data and feedback are synthetic; no live spend, advertiser adoption or performance outcome is claimed.
A real pilot requires verified substantiation, authenticated owners, approved budgets, live-data quality controls and explicit approval before any platform write.
